tips.text: Hit the enemy with Tongue Lash early in the lane. It slows them, heals Tahm Kench, and adds a stack of An Acquired Taste.
Land Tongue Lash on an enemy who already has three stacks to stun them. Then you can walk up and finish the trade.
Build stacks with basic attacks between Tongue Lash casts. Three stacks unlock the stun and Devour on an enemy champion.
Press Devour while Tongue Lash is in the air. It pulls an enemy with three stacks straight to you, and it costs nothing if the tongue misses.
Take trades you can't avoid, then wait out the grey health. Thick Skin heals you back if you go a few seconds without damage.
Use the Thick Skin shield when burst or a gank is about to kill you. If you can disengage safely, let it heal you instead.
Abyssal Dive takes a moment to channel, and enemies can see where you will land. Use it on a fleeing or stationary enemy, not one who can walk away.
Hit an enemy champion with Abyssal Dive to get back part of its cooldown and mana. It also knocks them up, so you can follow with Tongue Lash.
Don't swing at a distant target with Tongue Lash if a minion is in the way. It stops at the first enemy it hits.
Hit the enemy champion with basic attacks and Tongue Lash to build An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, your next Tongue Lash stuns them.
Aim Tongue Lash carefully. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way will block it.
Cast Devour while your tongue is in the air to pull in an enemy with three stacks. Devour doesn't go on cooldown if the tongue misses.
Devour a fragile ally who is being chased. They are untargetable and get a shield, and you can spit them out toward safety.
You can still cast Abyssal Dive while an ally is devoured, so use it to carry them out of a fight.
Abyssal Dive has a long channel, and enemies can see where you will land. Use it when they can't easily step away, and hit a champion to get some cooldown back.
Enemy stuns or knock-ups, or a Flash, will cancel your Abyssal Dive channel. Don't start it when the enemy can interrupt you.
Let Thick Skin build gray health while you trade. Press its active for a shield when more damage is coming, or wait out of combat to heal.
Stay near your carry and keep Devour ready. Position so you can reach them when an enemy dives in.
Hit Aatrox with Tongue Lash to slow him and heal, then trade back while he is slowed.
Take small trades to build An Acquired Taste stacks. At three stacks, Tongue Lash stuns him, so follow it with your attacks.
Stay out of the sweet spot at the end of The Darkin Blade. Step sideways, since each swing covers a different area.
Press Thick Skin when you are low and about to take more damage. If you can back off safely, let it heal you instead.
Use Abyssal Dive to escape or to hit him in a fight. It can be interrupted while you channel, so don't start it right next to him.
Hit Briar with Tongue Lash when she leaps in; she can't control her movement during Blood Frenzy, so she is easy to line up and she ends up slowed.
Press Thick Skin when Briar is about to burst you, since it turns the damage you stored into a shield. Let it heal you instead when she backs off.
Start Abyssal Dive early or away from Briar. It takes a moment to channel, and her Head Rush stun can interrupt it.
Land Abyssal Dive on her once she is stuck in melee with you. It knocks her up and refunds some cooldown.
Build three stacks of An Acquired Taste with attacks, then use Tongue Lash to stun her. Follow with Devour to swallow her and win the trade.
Hit Darius with Tongue Lash as he walks up. It slows him, and each hit heals you.
Stay out of Apprehend range, since it pulls you in and knocks you up. Tongue Lash him while Apprehend is on cooldown.
Use the Thick Skin shield when Darius is stacking Hemorrhage for a fight. Don't let him get his Noxian Guillotine kill.
Use Abyssal Dive to get away from Darius. Dive only when he can't punish the channel with a pull.
Don't cast Abyssal Dive or Devour onto Fiora while her Riposte is ready. She turns it into a stun on you.
Poke her with Tongue Lash from long range. It slows her and heals you, and she has to close the gap.
Bait her Riposte with a Tongue Lash, then Abyssal Dive once it is on cooldown.
Hold the Thick Skin shield for when she lunges in to trade. Use the heal instead if she backs off.
Watch the Vital marked on you; Fiora will try to hit it with Lunge. Step away from that side so she cannot get it.
Hit Gangplank with Tongue Lash for the slow and a heal. Use it to start your stacks so you can stun or Devour him later.
Do not hit Powder Kegs. When an enemy destroys one it is defused, and only Gangplank can make it explode.
Do not hold Abyssal Dive's channel while Gangplank is ready to cleanse. Remove Scurvy removes the knock up, so land it when it is on cooldown.
Use the Thick Skin shield when you take a big burst, such as a keg blast. Otherwise let it heal you.
After level 6, expect Cannon Barrage anywhere on the map when you are low. Back off, since its slow makes it hard to run.
Hit Garen with Tongue Lash as he walks up; it slows him and heals you. Decisive Strike will clear that slow, so do not count on it.
Keep poking Garen while he is hurt; each hit stops Perseverance from healing him.
Do not sit in melee while Judgment is spinning. Back out of its range, since he cannot attack while it lasts.
Save Thick Skin as a shield when Garen commits to a fight with Demacian Justice up; the shield soaks damage when it matters.
Stun him with Tongue Lash after three stacks of An Acquired Taste, then back away before he can use Decisive Strike on you.
Land Tongue Lash on Jayce when he leaps in or lines up a poke. It slows him and heals you.
Build three stacks on Jayce, then use Tongue Lash to stun him. Devour him mid-lash and he can't fight back.
Use the Thick Skin shield when Jayce's poke is landing, but only if you won't be healing soon. Using it means you skip the healing.
Abyssal Dive is easy to read, because Jayce can swap stance and run away during the channel. Use it when he is walled in or already hurt.
Jayce's Thundering Blow can knock you back out of range. Stay out of melee range unless you have stacks.
Build up An Acquired Taste with basic attacks, then land Tongue Lash to stun him. Do it when he has no Footwork ready to dash away.
Aim Tongue Lash carefully. It stops at the first enemy it hits, so a minion in the way takes the hit instead of him.
Use Thick Skin's shield when you expect a long trade, and take the healing when you can back off safely. The shield gives up the healing.
Before you dive, remember he can charge Path Maker and stun you. Abyssal Dive can be interrupted by crowd control while you channel.
Don't Devour him while All Out is ready; he can blink behind you. Use Devour once he has used his ultimate and you have three stacks.
Poke Malphite with Tongue Lash when he stands near minions; the slow and heal make trades good for you.
Avoid fighting while Malphite's Granite Shield is up, because his Armor is much higher. Wait until it breaks.
Respect Malphite at level 6; Unstoppable Force knocks you up and cannot be stopped once he starts.
Press Thick Skin's active to shield when Malphite bursts you, rather than waiting to heal it back.
Malphite's Seismic Shard is blocked by the first unit in its path? No: it targets you, so staying behind minions will not stop it.
Stay out of the line of Death's Grasp. Being pulled into Mordekaiser means Obliterate and his aura hit you.
Hit Mordekaiser with Tongue Lash to slow him and heal yourself, then walk away before his Darkness Rise aura starts.
Do not trade into Indestructible. It turns his damage into a shield, so wait for it to be used or to run out.
Use Thick Skin's shield when he commits to a fight. Otherwise let the stored health heal you once he is gone.
Keep Abyssal Dive for escaping or for engaging after he has used his abilities; the long channel is easy to see.
If Mordekaiser uses Realm of Death on you, expect to be alone with him, so fight it out or save your escapes for inside.
Land Tongue Lash on Rumble to slow him, and heal. Keep hitting him to build stacks.
Rumble cannot cast spells while he overheats, so go in then and trade hard.
Hold Thick Skin's shield for when Flamespitter is burning you. It turns the grey health into a shield.
Walk out of The Equalizer's fire; staying in it hurts a lot and slows you.
Use Abyssal Dive only when Rumble can't punish the long channel. Enemies can cancel it by stunning you.
Hit Sion with Tongue Lash when he starts charging Decimating Smash; it slows him and you heal.
Stay out of Sion's charge line, and sidestep a long Decimating Smash before it lands.
Use Thick Skin's shield when Sion's Soul Furnace burst or a full Smash is coming, and heal instead when you can disengage.
Do not chase Sion into a kill. His Glory in Death brings him back, hits fast and heals him.
Land Tongue Lash on Teemo to slow him and start stacking An Acquired Taste; he has little way to stop you closing in.
Walk through enemy mushrooms carefully; Noxious Trap is hidden. Shoot them with attacks to clear them before you push.
Use Thick Skin's shield when Teemo's poison and darts have built up damage, since Toxic Shot hurts over time.
Expect Teemo to vanish in brush with Guerrilla Warfare; stay out of it or ward it before you walk in.
Use Abyssal Dive to close the gap once Teemo is out of reach or to escape, as he is hard to catch on foot.
Once Teemo has three stacks, Tongue Lash stuns him, so follow up with Devour at level 6.
Hit Vayne with Tongue Lash to slow her. She is fragile, so lean on her when she steps up.
Stay away from walls behind you. Condemn stuns you if it pushes you into terrain.
Press Thick Skin when you take a big hit and need to survive. Save the healing for when you can disengage.
Abyssal Dive knocks Vayne up when you land it. Aim it where she will be, not where she stands, since she tumbles away.
Hit Yone with Tongue Lash to slow him and heal, then keep attacking to build stacks of An Acquired Taste.
Yone's dashes and shield make him slippery, so use Tongue Lash when he walks up to trade. At three stacks it stuns him.
Press Thick Skin to shield only when you expect more damage soon. If you can break off the fight, let it heal you instead.
Yone's Mortal Steel knock up hits at his third cast, so stay out of his reach once he has stacks. Bait the dash, then trade back.
Yone can't be pulled by Devour while he is in spirit form with displacement immunity on recast. Save Devour for a moment he can't escape.
Hit Bard with Tongue Lash to start building An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, your next Tongue Lash stuns him.
Walk over Caretaker's Shrine as the enemy. It is destroyed and nobody gets the heal.
Stay out of a straight line with your ally and keep minions out of the line. Cosmic Binding stuns when it hits a second enemy or a wall.
Use the Thick Skin shield when you are about to be stunned or burst. Take the heal instead when you can disengage and be left alone.
When Bard's Tempered Fate lands, don't dive into it. Wait it out, because nobody can be hurt inside it.
Aim Tongue Lash around Unbreakable or wait until Braum's shield is down; he blocks it when facing you.
Stay out of Braum's reach once he marks you; three more hits from him or his ally means you are stunned.
Stay out of Glacial Fissure's line. When it lands, don't walk across the ice, since it leaves you slowed.
Use Thick Skin's shield when you expect a burst of damage; Braum's slow and stun mean you cannot always wait for the healing.
Land Tongue Lash on Karma. It slows her, heals you, and she has no dash to escape the follow-up.
Build stacks of An Acquired Taste with attacks, then stun Karma with Tongue Lash for a safe all-in.
Karma is slowed by nothing, so stay out of Inner Flame's line. It stops at the first unit it hits, so keep a minion between you.
Watch for the circle left by a Mantra-boosted Inner Flame and leave it quickly, because it slows you and then bursts.
Move away from Focused Resolve's tether to break it. If it holds, you are rooted and easy to hit.
Stay out of Leona's Zenith Blade line, because a hit means she dashes onto you and roots you.
Hit Leona with Tongue Lash as she walks up. It slows her and heals you.
Use Thick Skin's shield when Leona is about to burst you. Skip it if you want the healing.
Don't start Abyssal Dive with Leona nearby. Her stun or root can interrupt the channel.
When Leona raises Eclipse, step back out of range before it detonates.
Do not channel Abyssal Dive while Lulu can reach you with Whimsy. A polymorph during the channel cancels the dive.
Hit Lulu with Tongue Lash to build stacks. Three stacks lets you stun her or Devour her.
Stand behind minions when Lulu attacks. They block Pix's bolts, and the slow from Glitterlance is easier to dodge.
Take Lulu's poke by storing it in Thick Skin. Hold the shield for a big hit, because using it stops the healing.
Stand behind minions to stop Light Binding from reaching you, since it only roots the first two enemies it hits.
Put stacks on Lux with basic attacks and Tongue Lash when she steps forward. Her low health makes a stun and Devour deadly.
Use the Thick Skin shield when Lux is about to fire Final Spark.
Use Abyssal Dive to cut across the lane onto Lux when she has used Lucent Singularity or Light Binding.
Move out of Lucent Singularity quickly. It slows you, and its blast slows you more.
Land Tongue Lash on Milio to build stacks of An Acquired Taste. At three stacks, the next Tongue Lash stuns him, so keep poking until then.
Milio is fragile and has no dash of his own. Cast Devour during Tongue Lash on him at three stacks to pull him away from his carry.
Stay behind your minions. Ultra Mega Fire Kick stuns the first enemy it hits, and a minion in front of you can block it.
Use the Thick Skin shield after taking a big hit from Milio's poke, or let it heal you if the fight is over.
Wait out Breath of Life before you dive in. It cleanses crowd control from his allies, so a stun or knock up is wasted.
Dodge Aqua Prison by moving sideways once Nami throws it; the bubble lands after a delay. If it misses, step in and trade, because her cooldown is long.
Hit Nami with Tongue Lash three times, with basic attacks or the ability, then Devour her. Her Aqua Prison stun can't save her.
Land Tongue Lash on Nami when she steps up to cast; it slows her and heals you. Nami is fragile, so a few hits hurt her.
Use Abyssal Dive to jump onto Nami when she is out of position. It knocks up everything in the area.
Her enemy-hitting spells cost her mana, so poke her with Tongue Lash when she wastes them.
Back off when her ally is empowered by Tidecaller's Blessing; the slow and extra damage only last a few hits.
Step out of the path of Tidal Wave; it travels slowly. Press Thick Skin if you can't dodge it.
Stay behind your minions so Dredge Line stops on them; Nautilus's anchor hits the first enemy in its path.
Use Tongue Lash to slow Nautilus when he walks up, and watch your stacks of An Acquired Taste to know when you can stun him.
Press the Thick Skin shield when Nautilus dives in with a stun combo; he will burst you before healing matters.
Hold still when Riptide goes off next to you until the waves finish, instead of running into the later explosions.
Kill or avoid Nautilus's shield when he has Titan's Wrath up; his attacks then hurt everyone near the target.
Land Tongue Lash on Pantheon when he steps up; it slows him and builds stacks toward a stun.
Do not walk into Aegis Assault from the front; hit Pantheon from the side or wait it out.
Use Thick Skin's shield when Pantheon jumps in with Shield Vault, since it stuns you.
Keep your health up; Comet Spear hits much harder against low health enemies.
Move out of the marker when Grand Starfall begins; there is a long warning before he lands.
Keep Thick Skin's shield for when Pyke is about to burst you; the shield only lasts a short time, so press it as he commits.
Hit Pyke with Tongue Lash to slow him, then follow with your basic attacks to build stacks of An Acquired Taste.
Pyke is fragile, so with three stacks, use Tongue Lash to stun him and punish him while he cannot act.
Do not chase Pyke when he vanishes; he heals back damage while hidden. Back off and wait for him to show himself.
Stay close to your ally. Devour can pull them out of danger, and its shield soaks up a Pyke combo.
Hit Senna with Tongue Lash when she walks up to attack. She has no escape, and the slow makes her an easy target for your next hit.
Stay out of Senna's long attack range early, because she outranges you and will poke you down. Close in only once your Tongue Lash is ready.
Use Thick Skin's shield after Senna's poke lands if you plan to keep trading. If you plan to back off, let the stored health heal you instead.
Build three stacks of An Acquired Taste on Senna, then cast Devour on her. She loses her damage and her allies see you carry her away.
Dodge Last Embrace by moving sideways before it sticks. Being rooted lets her team punish you, and Abyssal Dive can't be cast while you are stuck.
Keep Abyssal Dive for when Seraphine is locked in place or you need to close the gap. It knocks up everyone it lands on.
Step out of the line of Beat Drop. Once you are slowed, her next hit roots you.
Land Tongue Lash on Seraphine to slow her and heal yourself. It is your best answer when she stands at range.
Use the Thick Skin shield when she lands a big hit and you can't safely wait for the heal.
Land Tongue Lash on Sona when she steps forward to cast. It slows her and heals you, and she is fragile.
Build three stacks on Sona, then Devour her. She cannot act while swallowed, and it takes her out of the fight.
Use Thick Skin's shield when Sona's poke is heavy. Let it heal you if you can stay out of damage for a few seconds.
Do not stand where Crescendo can reach you when you commit. It stuns you and your team can be caught.
Hit Sona with Abyssal Dive when she is out of position. It knocks her up and you get part of the cooldown back.
Watch for Thresh starting Death Sentence; it has a long cast time, so step aside or break line of sight before the scythe leaves.
Use Thick Skin's shield when Thresh and his partner are poking you hard, and let it heal you when they back off.
Hit Thresh with Tongue Lash to slow him, then follow with attacks to build An Acquired Taste toward a stun.
Do not channel Abyssal Dive near Thresh. A pull or stun from Flay or Death Sentence can interrupt your dive.
Devour your ally when Thresh aims at them. They dodge the hook and get a shield.
